title: Japanese-Style Banh Mi
description: A fusion of Japanese and Vietnamese flavors in a crunchy banh mi. Perfect for a quick lunch or snack.
instructions: 1. Cook the vermicelli noodles according to the package instructions.
2. In a small bowl, whisk together the rice vinegar and a pinch of sugar.
3. Add the pickled carrots, cucumber, and daikon radish to the bowl and toss to coat.
4. Grill the pork or tofu until cooked through, then slice into thin strips.
5. Spread a layer of Japanese mayonnaise on the bottom half of the baguette or banh mi bread.
6. Add a layer of cooked vermicelli noodles, followed by the pickled vegetables.
7. Top with sliced grilled pork or tofu, and sprinkle with sesame seeds if desired.
8. Place the top half of the baguette or banh mi bread on the sandwich.
9. Slice the sandwich in half and serve immediately.
10. Enjoy your delicious Japanese-Style Banh Mi!
